column1: # OSDR studies in the hardware ladder — the auditable core of the cross-study comparison.
# The model predicts a GRADED outcome across enclosure types. LunarLeaf-CFD T11 gives 12 h
# carbon gain as a percentage of Earth's: sealed BRIC 1, micropore-tape CARA 90, vented 100.
# So the carbon-starvation signature should be strongest in sealed hardware, intermediate
# under tape, and weakest when vented.
# Every field below was read off OSDR by scripts/probe_studies.py on 2026-09-08, not assumed.
# `contrast` is the exact Log2fc_ column used, and it is always MATCHED: the two sides differ
# only in Space Flight vs Ground Control. A study offering flight-vs-ground contrasts that
# also swap genotype, ecotype or light treatment (OSD-678 has 36 such, only 6 matched) would
# confound the very thing being tested.
# `include` is a judgement and each exclusion carries its reason. The binding constraint is
# TISSUE: a photosynthesis prediction says nothing about roots, so root studies are out even
# though their data is otherwise perfectly good.
# enclosure_class : sealed | tape | vented
# carbon_pct_earth: LunarLeaf-CFD T11 prediction for that enclosure class
accession
OSD-522
column10: CONFIRMED: "light wavelength composition of 85% red, 15% blue, and 60 umol m-2 s-1 intensity" (OSDR protocol)
column14: Flagship. Only study here with a matched proteome. GeneLab ships raw RSEM counts but no DGE, so PyDESeq2 is run on the 6 flight vs 6 ground shoot samples.

column1: OSD-38
column10: INFERRED: BRIC PDFU canisters have no growth illumination; OSDR protocol mentions only 1-2 h white light to synchronise germination, never a growth photoperiod. Weaker evidence than OSD-321.
column14: Independent sealed-hardware replicate, and the second study with a proteome (soluble + membrane). One matched contrast, unambiguous.

column1: OSD-321
column10: CONFIRMED: "cultivate sterile dark-grown seedlings germinated aboard the ISS for a 14 day period" (OSDR description)
column13: Log2fc_(Space Flight & Wild Type)v(Ground Control & Wild Type)
column14: Third sealed replicate. Wild-type arm only; the four UPR-mutant arms are left aside as they perturb the very stress response we are measuring.

column1: OSD-678-light
column10: CONFIRMED: "Light Treatment" is an explicit study factor level and names the contrast
column13: Log2fc_(Col-0 & Wild Type & Space Flight & Light Treatment)v(Col-0 & Wild Type & Ground Control & Light Treatment)
column14: Intermediate enclosure. Leaves, confirmed by the study description contrasting leaves with root tips.

column1: OSD-678-dark
column10: CONFIRMED: "Dark Treatment" is an explicit study factor level and names the contrast
column13: Log2fc_(Col-0 & Wild Type & Space Flight & Dark Treatment)v(Col-0 & Wild Type & Ground Control & Dark Treatment)
column14: INTERNAL CONTROL. Same hardware, same plants, no light. Without photosynthesis there is no CO2 drawdown, so the model predicts the carbon-starvation signature should be ABSENT here while present in the light arm.

column1: OSD-427
column10: CONFIRMED: "Plants in the Veggie hardware were exposed to constant light conditions of 100-135 umoles/m2/s PAR" (OSDR protocol). NOTE this is ~2x the PAR of OSD-522.
column13: Log2fc_(Wild Type & Space Flight & leaf)v(Wild Type & Ground control & leaf)
column14: The vented arm. Explicit leaf tissue and a wild-type contrast; the elp2-5 and met1-7 methylation mutants are left aside.

column1: OSD-120
column14: EXCLUDED: root tips. The study description states the CARA comparison was made "in the root tips". A photosynthesis and photorespiration prediction does not apply to non-photosynthetic tissue.

column1: OSD-193
column14: EXCLUDED: roots. Description states gene expression was profiled "in roots".

column1: OSD-281
column14: EXCLUDED: roots. Description states gene expression was profiled "in roots".

column1: OSD-218
column14: EXCLUDED: tissue not stated in the metadata and the description dwells on "root system development"; same APEX03-2 project as the two root studies above. Including it on a guess would put possibly-root data into a shoot comparison.

column1: OSD-16
column14: EXCLUDED: OSDR holds no processed files for this study, only 16 files total and none usable. It was the intended vented proteome arm; its absence is why the vented arm is transcriptome-only.

column1: OSD-7
column14: EXCLUDED: Affymetrix microarray, not RNA-seq. Cross-platform log2 fold changes are not comparable on the same scale as the eight GeneLab RNA-seq studies here.
